4499 Rhodos {hrod'-os}

可能源自 rhodon (玫瑰); 專有地名

AV - Rhodes 1; 1

羅底 = "玫瑰色的"
1) 基克拉澤群島(Cyclades)中著名的一座島，在加里亞(Caria)和呂喀亞(Lycia)對面,
   羅底是首都 (#徒 21:1|)
record.edic_text:
4499 Rhodos {hrod'-os}

probably from rhodon (a rose);; n pr loc

AV - Rhodes 1; 1

Rhodes = "rosy"
1) a well known island of the Cyclades opposite Caria and Lycia, with
   a Rhodes as the capital city
